# Data

* Sample information

Here I will remove lowQual samples since the beginning. Because making 2 tiers isn't involve with their quality anyway.
```{r}
lowQual <- c("PabK14-03SM_SR1","PabK14-03RO_SR2","Pab738_2_FMG_MIR1")

samples <- bind_rows(
  read_tsv(here("doc/metadata_SE.tsv"), show_col_types=F) %>%
    dplyr::filter(! grepl("-unk",stage)) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(sample = NGI_ID,
                  sampleName = User_ID) %>%
    mutate(temp = gsub("PabK14-03","",sampleName),
           Stage = gsub("-unk","",stage)) %>%
    separate_wider_delim(temp, delim = "_", names = c("SampleType","rep")) %>%
    mutate(Dataset = "SE",
           Type = "SE",
           StageType = gsub("S","SE_",Stage),
           Replicate = substr(rep,3,3),
           SampleName = paste0(Stage,"-",SampleType,"-",Replicate)) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-stage, -Mreads, -`>=Q30`, -Status, -rep, -replicate),
  read_csv(here("doc/metadataZE_mRNA_miRNA.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(! is.na(miR_NGI_ID)) %>% 
    mutate(StageType = paste0(Type, "_", Stage),
           Stage = paste0("Z",Stage)) %>% 
    mutate(StageType = factor(StageType, levels = c(paste0("SD_",1:3),
                                                    "ZE_4","FG_4",
                                                    "ZE_5","FG_5",
                                                    "ZE_6","FG_6",
                                                    "ZE_7","FG_7",
                                                    "ZE_8-9","FG_8-9",
                                                    "ZE_10","FG_10")),
           Stage = factor(as.character(Stage), levels = paste0("Z",as.character(c(1:7,"8-9",10)))),
           Dataset = "ZE") %>% 
    dplyr::select(-SampleID, -lincRNA_ID) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(sample = miR_NGI_ID,
                  sampleName = miR_User_ID,
                  description = SampleDescription)) %>% 
  mutate(StageType = factor(StageType,
                        levels = c(
                          paste0("SE_",1:8),
                          paste0("SD_",1:3),
                          paste0("ZE_",c(4:7,"8-9",10)),
                          paste0("FG_",c(4:7,"8-9",10)))),
         Stage = factor(Stage, levels = c(paste0("S",1:8),paste0("Z",c(1:7,"8-9",10)))),
         Type = factor(Type, level = c("SE","SD","ZE","FG"))) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(! sampleName %in% lowQual)

sortedSamples <- samples %>% 
  arrange(Stage) %>% 
  arrange(Type)
```

* Count data

Count from bowtie alignment on mature miRNAs that were predicted by miRDP2
````{r}
counts <- read_tsv(here("data/analysis/results/bowtie/count_DE.txt"), show_col_types = F) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene_id") %>%
  setNames(gsub("_count","",basename(colnames(.)))) %>%
  as.matrix() %>% 
  .[, samples$sample] 

countm <- read_tsv(here("data/analysis/results/bowtie/count_DE.txt"), show_col_types = F) %>%
  filter(! Gene_id == "Unaligned") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene_id") %>%
  setNames(gsub("_count","",basename(colnames(.)))) %>%
  as.matrix() %>% 
  .[, samples$sample] 

expressed <- rownames(countm[rowSums(countm) > 0,])

countSE <- countm[, dplyr::filter(samples, Dataset == "SE")$sample] %>%
  .[rowSums(.) > 0,]
countZE <- countm[, dplyr::filter(samples, Dataset == "ZE")$sample] %>%
  .[rowSums(.) > 0,]
countZESD <- countZE[, dplyr::filter(samples, Type == "SD")$sample] %>%
  .[rowSums(.) > 0,]
countZEZE <- countZE[, dplyr::filter(samples, Type == "ZE")$sample] %>%
  .[rowSums(.) > 0,]
countZEFG <- countZE[, dplyr::filter(samples, Type == "FG")$sample] %>%
  .[rowSums(.) > 0,]
countSem <- countm[, dplyr::filter(samples, StageType %in% paste0("SE_",1:6))$sample] %>%
  .[rowSums(.) > 0,]
countSDL <- countm[, dplyr::filter(samples, StageType %in% paste0("SE_",7:8))$sample] %>%
  .[rowSums(.) > 0,]
````

```{r, echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# Grouping the known and variant of known miRNAs based on the blast result that hit to the same known miRNAs
blast_group <- mature_blast %>%
  mutate(Group = ifelse(Query_acc %in% mature_known, "known",
                        ifelse(Query_acc %in% mature_variant, "variant", NA)),
         Plant = ifelse(Query_acc %in% names(mature_plant), "plant","other")) %>%
  split(f = .$`Hit acc`)

mature_represent <- blast_group %>%
  map(function(d){
    
    if(any(grepl("known",d$Group))){
      d <- filter(d, Group == "known")
    }
    
    if(any(grepl("plant",d$Plant))){
      d <- filter(d, Plant == "plant")
    }
    
    d %>%
      slice_max(Identity * (-log10(`E-value`)), n = 1) %>%
      slice_max(`Query cover` * `Hit cover`, n = 1)
  })
# There are `r length(mature_represent)` known miRNAs that have exact sequence or variant of them in the dataset.
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# Number of known and variant of known miRNAs that hit to the same miRBase entry
map_df(blast_group,nrow) %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=V1)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  xlab("Predicted sequence variations per known miRNA in miRBase") +
  theme_bw()
```

# miRDP2's miRNA prediction results

Make annot
```{r}
annotmiR <- data.frame("id" = rownames(countm)) %>%
  mutate(plant = ifelse(id %in% names(mature_plant), "plant", "nonplant"),
         known = ifelse(id %in% mature_known, "known",
                        ifelse(id %in% mature_variant, "variant", "novel"))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(id,plant,known) %>%
  mutate(express = id %in% rownames(countm)[rowSums(countm) > 0])
```

## Size distribution of predicted miRNAs

All
```{r}
sizemiR <- mature %>% 
  map(nchar) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename(size = V1)

ggplot(sizemiR, aes(x=size)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(sizemiR, aes(x=size)) +
  geom_density() +
  theme_bw()

# ggplot(sizemiR, aes(x=size)) +
#   geom_density(bw = 1) +
#   theme_bw()
```

`r emoji("point_right")` **There are two main peaks, at 21bp and 24bp.**

divide into known or variant or novel
```{r}
sizemiR2 <- sizemiR %>% 
  rownames_to_column("id") %>%
  left_join(annotmiR,by = "id")

ggplot(sizemiR2, aes(x=size, group = plant, colour = plant)) +
  geom_density() +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(sizemiR2, aes(x=size, group = known, colour = known)) +
  geom_density() +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(sizemiR2, aes(x=size, group = express, colour = express)) +
  geom_density() +
  theme_bw()
```

`r emoji("point_right")` **The peak at 24bp is predominantly non-plant and novel miRNAs.**

## First base of predicted miRNAs

```{r}
firstBase <- mature %>% 
  map(substr, start = 1, stop = 1) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("id") %>%
  left_join(annotmiR,by = "id") %>%
  rename(firstB = V1) %>%
  group_by(plant, known, express) %>%
  count(firstB)

ggplot(firstBase, aes(x=firstB, y = n, fill = plant)) +
  geom_col() +
  ggtitle("All miRNAs") +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(firstBase, aes(x=firstB, y = n, fill = known)) +
  geom_col() +
  ggtitle("All miRNAs") +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(firstBase, aes(x=firstB, y = n, fill = express)) +
  geom_col() +
  ggtitle("All miRNAs") +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(filter(firstBase, express), aes(x=firstB, y = n, fill = known)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(plant)) +
  ggtitle("Expressed miRNAs") +
  theme_bw()

```

## Size and first base
```{r}
dat <- mature %>%

  as.data.frame() %>%

  rownames_to_column("id") %>%
  left_join(annotmiR,by = "id") %>%
```

## Size and firstbase, Filter only to expressed miR

make data frame
```{r}
dat <- matureDF %>% 
  dplyr::filter(id %in% expressed) %>%
  mutate(plant = ifelse(id %in% names(mature_plant), "plant", "nonplant") %>% 
           factor(levels = c("plant", "nonplant")),
         known = ifelse(id %in% mature_known, "known",
                        ifelse(id %in% mature_variant, "variant", "novel")) %>% 
           factor(levels = c("known", "variant", "novel")),
         express = ifelse((id %in% rownames(countSE)) & (id %in% rownames(countZE)), "Both",
                 ifelse(id %in% rownames(countSE), "SEonly",
                        ifelse(id %in% rownames(countZE), "ZEonly","None"))),
         size = nchar(mature),
         firstBase = substr(mature, start = 1, stop = 1) %>% 
           factor(levels = c("T", "A", "C", "G")))
```

## plant miRNA prediction counts

Number of miRDP2-predicted mature miRNA sequences that pass plant criteria per sample:
```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=15}
dat <- data.frame(sample = names(passed_plant_criteria_id),
                  miRNAs_count = map_dbl(passed_plant_criteria_id,length),
                  known = map_dbl(passed_plant_criteria_id, ~ sum(.x %in% mature_known)),
                  variant = map_dbl(passed_plant_criteria_id, ~ sum(.x %in% mature_variant))) %>%
  mutate(novel = miRNAs_count - known - variant) %>%
  inner_join(samples, by="sample") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(known,variant,novel), names_to = "miRNA", values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(miRNA = factor(miRNA, levels = c("novel","known","variant")))

ggplot(dat, aes(x=SampleName, y=count, fill=miRNA)) +
  geom_col() +
  ggtitle("count of miRNAs that pass plant criteria") +
  #geom_text(aes(x=sampleName, y=miRNAs_count + 10, label=miRNAs_count), col = "grey40") +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(Dataset), scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1))
```

`r emoji("point_right")` **The majority of predicted miRNAs are known.**

## Venn, Check replicates

Here we will separate out any miR that does not show up in not all available replicates of at least 1 timepoint
```{r}
stopifnot(all(colnames(countm) == samples$sample))
repCount <- countm %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  split(., samples$StageType) %>% 
  map(~ colSums(.x > 0)) %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "StageType") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("StageType") %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame()
maxRepCount <- table(samples$StageType)
acceptRepCount <- ifelse(maxRepCount < 4, maxRepCount,
                         ifelse(maxRepCount == 4, 3, 4))
stopifnot(all(colnames(repCount) == names(acceptRepCount)))
repCountCheck <- sweep(repCount, 2, acceptRepCount[colnames(repCount)], FUN = ">=")

repChecked <- rownames(repCountCheck)[rowSums(repCountCheck) > 0]
write_lines(repChecked, here("data/analysis/results/repChecked.txt"))
```

# (1st tier) SE and ZE together

## Preparation for data normalization

For visualization, the data is submitted to a variance stabilization
transformation using _DESeq2_. The dispersion is estimated independently
of the sample tissue and replicate. 

````{r}
# Beware the order of samples when using DESeqDataSetFromMatrix !!
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=countk, colData=samples, design = ~ StageType)
colnames(dds) <- dds$SampleName

saveRDS(dds,file=here("data/analysis/results/ddsFinal.rds"))
````

## size factors 

(_i.e._ the sequencing library size effect)

````{r}
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds) %>% 
  suppressMessages()
````

Assess whether there might be a difference in library size linked to a
given metadata

````{r}
boxplot(split(t(sizeFactors(dds)),dds$Dataset),las=2,log="y",
        main="Sequencing libraries size factor by Dataset")
abline(h=1, col = "Red", lty = 3)
boxplot(split(t(sizeFactors(dds)),dds$StageType),las=2,log="y",
        main="Sequencing libraries size factor by Dataset")
abline(h=1, col = "Red", lty = 3)
````


````{r}
# plot(sizeFactors(dds),
#      log10(colSums(counts(dds))),ylab="raw depth",
#      xlab="average scaling factor",
#      col=rainbow(n=nlevels(dds$Dataset))[as.integer(dds$Dataset)],pch=19)
# legend("bottomright",fill=rainbow(n=nlevels(dds$Dataset)),
#        legend=levels(dds$Dataset),cex=0.6)
plot(sizeFactors(dds),
     log10(colSums(counts(dds))),ylab="raw depth",
     xlab="average scaling factor",
     col=rainbow(n=nlevels(dds$StageType))[as.integer(dds$StageType)],pch=19)
legend("bottomright",fill=rainbow(n=nlevels(dds$StageType)),
       legend=levels(dds$StageType),cex=0.6)
````

## Variance Stabilising Transformation

````{r}
vsd <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds, blind=TRUE)
vst <- assay(vsd)
vst <- vst - min(vst)
````

## Validation

let's look at standard deviations before and after VST normalization. 
This plot is to see whether there is a dependency of SD on the mean. 

Before:  

````{r}
meanSdPlot(log1p(counts(dds))[rowSums(counts(dds))>0,])
````

After:

````{r}
meanSdPlot(vst[rowSums(vst)>0,])
````

After VST normalization, the red line is almost horizontal which indicates
no dependency of variance on mean (homoscedastic).

`r emoji("point_right")` **The variance stabilization helps with expression values of miRNAs that very highly express.**

## QC on the normalised data
### PCA

````{r}
pc <- prcomp(t(vst))
percent <- round(summary(pc)$importance[2,]*100)
````

Using PCAtools

````{r}
p <- pca(vst,colData(dds))
````

### Scree plot

We define the number of variable of the model:

````{r}
nvar <- 2
````

An the number of possible combinations

````{r}
nlevel <- nlevels(dds$Dataset)
````

We devise the optimal number of components using two methods

````{r}
horn <- suppressWarnings(parallelPCA(vst))
elbow <- findElbowPoint(p$variance)
````

We plot the percentage explained by different components and try to empirically assess whether
the observed number of components would be in agreement with our model's assumptions.

* the red line represents number of variables in the model  
* the orange line represents number of variable combinations.
* the black dotted, annotate lines represent the optimal number of components 
reported by the horn and elbow methods.


````{r}
ggplot(tibble(x=1:length(percent),y=cumsum(percent),p=percent),aes(x=x,y=y)) +
  geom_line() + geom_col(aes(x,p)) + scale_y_continuous("variance explained (%)",limits=c(0,100)) +
  scale_x_continuous("Principal component",breaks=1:length(percent),minor_breaks=NULL) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept=nvar,colour="red",linetype="dashed",linewidth=0.5) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=cumsum(percent)[nvar],colour="red",linetype="dashed",linewidth=0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=nlevel,colour="orange",linetype="dashed",linewidth=0.5) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept=cumsum(percent)[nlevel],colour="orange",linetype="dashed",linewidth=0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(horn$n,elbow),colour="black",linetype="dotted",linewidth=0.5) +
  geom_label(aes(x = horn$n + 1, y = cumsum(percent)[horn$n],label = 'Horn', vjust = 1)) +
  geom_label(aes(x = elbow + 1, y = cumsum(percent)[elbow],label = 'Elbow', vjust = 1))
````

### Correlation
This is a plot showing the correlation between the PC and the model variables. Note that while this might be relevant 
for a linear variable, it is less so for categorical variables. Sorting categorical variables in a linear order according to the PCs above might help.

No need to edit anything in our case, as we only have to values for every variable.



Plotting only the relevant variables.

````{r}
stopifnot(all(p$metadata$SampleName == names(sizeFactors(dds))))
````

### UMAPs

Since the variance explained plot imply that many PCs are informative, we will try using Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection.

```{r, message=FALSE}
um <- umap(t(vst), random_state=123456) %>% 
  keep_at("layout") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  setNames(c("UMAP1","UMAP2")) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleName") %>%
  left_join(samples, by = "SampleName") %>%
  left_join(data.frame("SampleName" = names(sizeFactors(dds)), "sizeFactor" = sizeFactors(dds), "log10TotalExp" = log10(colSums(counts(dds)))), by = "SampleName")
  

ggplot(um,aes(x=UMAP1,y=UMAP2,col=StageType,fill=StageType,group=StageType,label=SampleName)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  #geom_text(vjust = 0, nudge_y = 0.07) +
  #ggalt::geom_encircle(alpha = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = anncol[["StageType"]]) +
  theme_bw()
ggplot(um,aes(x=UMAP1,y=UMAP2,col=sizeFactor,group=1,label=SampleName)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  viridis::scale_color_viridis(option = "C") +
  #geom_text(vjust = 0, nudge_y = 0.07) +
  theme_bw()
ggplot(um,aes(x=UMAP1,y=UMAP2,col=log10TotalExp,group=1,label=SampleName)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  viridis::scale_color_viridis(option = "D") +
  #geom_text(vjust = 0, nudge_y = 0.07) +
  theme_bw()
```

````{r}
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))
````

## Heatmap

````{r}
mat <- t(scale(t(vst[rowSums(vst) > 0 & ! rownames(vst) == "Unaligned",])))

annot <- data.frame(vst) %>%
  rownames_to_column("id") %>%
  mutate(plant = ifelse(id %in% names(mature_plant), "yes", "no"),
         known = ifelse(id %in% mature_known, "known",
                        ifelse(id %in% mature_variant, "variant", "novel"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(id,plant,known) %>%
  column_to_rownames("id")

annotcond <- samples %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleName, Dataset) %>%
  left_join(data.frame(SampleName = names(sizeFactors(dds)), sizeFactor = sizeFactors(dds)), by = "SampleName") %>%
  column_to_rownames("SampleName")

# brewer.pal(3,"Set3")
# brewer.pal(3,"Dark2")
# brewer.pal(5,"Oranges")
# brewer.pal(5,"Blues")
anncol2 = list("plant" = c("no" = "#D95F02","yes" = "#1B9E77"),
              "known" = c("known" = "#0F5B71", "variant" = "#EEC06B", "novel" = "#CD2932"),
              "Dataset" = c("SE" = "#FD8D3C", "ZE" = "#6BAED6"),
              "sizeFactor" = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9,"RdPu"))(20))

hm <- pheatmap(mat,
               color = hpal,
               annotation_row = annot,
               annotation_col = annotcond,
               annotation_colors = anncol2,
               border_color = NA,
               clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
               clustering_method = "ward.D2",
               show_rownames = FALSE,
               labels_col = samples$SampleName,
               angle_col = 90,
               legend = FALSE)
hm
````

## more heatmaps

### Sample-wise

Scaled variance-stabilized transformation
```{r, fig.height=9, fig.width=12}
mat <- vst[kept,sortedSamples$SampleName] %>% 
  t() %>% 
  scale() %>% 
  t()
hm <- pheatmap(mat,
             color = hpal,
             annotation_col = sortedSamples %>% dplyr::select(StageType, sampleName) %>% column_to_rownames("sampleName"),
             annotation_row = annotRow,
             annotation_colors = anncol,
             border_color = NA,
             cluster_cols = FALSE,
             treeheight_row = 0,
             show_rownames = FALSE,
             clustering_method = "ward.D2",
             labels_col = sortedSamples$StageType,
             angle_col = 90,
             fontsize_col = 6,
             legend = TRUE)
hm
```

### Average per stage

Scaled averaged variance-stabilized transformation
```{r}
mat <- vst[kept,sortedSamples$SampleName] %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("SampleName") %>% 
  left_join(sortedSamples %>% dplyr::select(SampleName, StageType), by = "SampleName") %>% 
  split(., .$StageType) %>% 
  map(dplyr::select, -SampleName, -StageType) %>% 
  map(colMeans) %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "StageType") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("StageType") %>% 
  as.matrix() %>% 
  scale() %>% 
  t()
hm <- pheatmap(mat,
             color = hpal,
             annotation_col = sortedSamples %>% mutate(Type = ifelse(Type=="SE","Sem", ifelse(Type=="ZE","Zem",as.character(Type)))) %>% dplyr::select(StageType, Type) %>% distinct() %>% column_to_rownames("StageType"),
             annotation_row = annotRow,
             annotation_colors = anncol,
             border_color = NA,
             cluster_cols = FALSE,
             treeheight_row = 0,
             show_rownames = FALSE,
             clustering_method = "ward.D2",
             labels_col = unique(sortedSamples$StageType),
             angle_col = 90,
             fontsize_col = 7,
             legend = TRUE)
hm
```

## Clustering of samples

Below we assess the previous dendrogram's reproducibility and plot the clusters with au and bp where:

* __au (Approximately Unbiased): computed by multiscale bootstrap resampling__ `r emoji("point_left")` a better approximation
* __bp (Bootstrap Probability): computed by normal bootstrap resampling__

`r emoji("warning")` Clusters with AU larger than 95% are highlighted by rectangles, which are strongly supported by data

Here I use all miRNA
````{r,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
hm.pvclust <- pvclust(data = t(scale(t(vst[rowSums(vst) > 0 & ! rownames(vst) == "Unaligned",]))),
                       method.hclust = "ward.D2",
                       nboot = 100, parallel = FALSE) %>% suppressWarnings()

plot(hm.pvclust)
pvrect(hm.pvclust)
````

And here using only miRNA that passed plant criteria
````{r,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
hm.pvclust <- pvclust(data = t(scale(t(vst[rowSums(vst) > 0 & rownames(vst) %in% names(mature_plant),]))),
                       method.hclust = "ward.D2",
                       nboot = 100, parallel = FALSE) %>% suppressWarnings()

plot(hm.pvclust)
pvrect(hm.pvclust)
````

<details><summary>bootstrapping results as a table</summary>
```{r}
print(hm.pvclust, digits=3)
```
</details>
